title: Finding and using interpretable latents in a neutrino foundation model with sparse autoencoders
abstract: arXiv:2608.26090v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We present a first application of sparse-autoencoder-based mechanistic interpretability to particle physics. Studying a neutrino foundation model pretrained on IceCube data and fine-tuned for direction reconstruction, we identify a validated atlas of physical concepts in the model representation, using a strict validation protocol consisting of held-out tests, matched nuisance controls, and replication across independent dictionary trainings. Causal interventions show that the direction head barely draws on this atlas. Motivated by this underused information, we train an uncertainty head on the same event-level representation to predict the model's angular reconstruction error. translated_title: 在基于稀疏自编码器的中微子基础模型中发现并利用可解释潜在特征
translated_abstract: 我们首次将基于稀疏自编码器的机制可解释性应用于粒子物理学。研究一个在IceCube数据上预训练并针对方向重建进行微调的中微子基础模型，我们通过严格的验证协议（包括留出测试、匹配的干扰控制和独立字典训练中的重复验证）识别出模型表示中物理概念的有效图谱。因果干预表明，方向头几乎不依赖该图谱。受此未充分利用信息的启发，我们在相同的事件级表示上训练一个不确定性头，以预测模型的角重建误差。与方向头不同，它因果性地依赖于图谱中的质量和亮度特征。在20%的选择效率下，该可解释估计器将中位角分辨率从20.2°提高到3.2°。这些结果表明，机制可解释性为高能物理中的基础模型提供了一种实用工具。
tldr: 本文首次将稀疏自编码器机制可解释性应用于粒子物理中微子模型，发现未利用的物理概念图谱，并通过不确定性头将角分辨率从20.2°提升至3.2°。
en_tdlr: This paper applies sparse-autoencoder mechanistic interpretability to a neutrino foundation model, uncovering an underused physical atlas and improving angular resolution from 20.2° to 3.2° via an uncertainty head.
